name: Callias of Argos
bio: Callias of Argos is one of the named epigrammatists whose short poems are preserved in the Greek Anthology. Paton's Index of Authors says the poet's date is unknown.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the fourth volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Loeb, 1918): Book XI: 232.

poems.title: Book XI, 232
poems.author: Callias of Argos
poems.text: You were always, Polycritus, as good as gold, but now after drinking you have suddenly become a sort of rabid curse. I believe you are always wicked ; wine is the test of character; it is not now that you become wicked, but now you have been shown to be so.
